column1: # Rows db.x7.* (line RG item X7-1, 2026-11-27): BLASTN against a database sequence whose Seq-align id (or display id) NCBI's scope finds as a query of its batch by a generated id (lcl|Query_N of a query read without -parse_deflines, or a PSSM query's local id): LOSAT refuses each format that shows the query in its place (report::query_bioseq::FoundWriters; the Seq-annots, the archive, SAM, tables of fields that read nothing of it and the organism report of a sequence without a taxid that the taxonomy database names are NCBI's bytes). Probes X/xt/x7/x71/probe2 of line RG.
